summary: The legal domain ends at n = 8 while the Catalan output changes sharply, making three-tier runtime classification unreliable. A direct cached-interval construction proof verifies the required O(n C_n) upper bound.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The verified source constraint is 1 <= n <= 8.

replacement_checks.evidence: For each cached interval, the loops create one root for every Cartesian-product pair of left and right BSTs for every root value, enumerating the Catalan recurrence without recomputing interval forests. There are C_n returned trees, and materializing or structurally validating their n-node representations costs O(n C_n); the cached shared graph and recursion remain within that upper bound.

The source-fidelity-verified examples cover all five structures for n = 3 and the n = 1 boundary; black-box real-test execution verifies all existing ordinary structural checks without inspecting their definitions.
